label: supertonic3-int8-M2-8step
name: Supertonic 3 INT8, 8 steps (today)
verdict: OK (MIT code, OpenRAIL-M model, no phonemizer). Already shipping behind the Terms gate.

label: kokoro-fp32-af_heart
name: Kokoro-82M fp32
verdict: OK *if* espeak-ng fallback is replaced (Apache weights, Apache misaki lexicon; espeak fallback GPL).

label: kitten-nano-fp32-0.8-Jasper
name: KittenTTS nano 0.8 fp32
verdict: Weights OK (Apache). Front end is espeak-ng (GPL); needs a non-GPL G2P that mimics espeak IPA.

label: piper-en_US-ljspeech-high
name: Piper ljspeech high
verdict: Blocked as-is: piper1 engine is GPL-3 and phonemizes with espeak-ng (GPL). Voice data public domain.

label: piper-en_US-lessac-medium
name: Piper lessac medium
verdict: Blocked: GPL front end, and the lessac voice is research-only (Blizzard 2013 licence).

label: pocket-alba
name: Kyutai Pocket TTS (alba)
verdict: OK (MIT code, CC-BY-4.0 weights, alba voice CC-BY-4.0, no phonemizer). Needs attribution. Avoid built-in voices from Expresso/EARS (non-commercial). Needs a non-PyTorch runtime on iOS.
